# Mohsen Golzad — Frontend Developer Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Mohsen Golzad, a frontend developer based in Tehran, Iran.
> Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.

## About

Mohsen Golzad is a frontend developer focused on building modern, clean, and responsive user interfaces. Skilled in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and currently expanding into TypeScript and Next.js.
